components.notes: CHIP_PU (pin 9) is the MCU_RST net, driven by the AXP192's PWROK, pulled up to MCU_VDD by R11 10 kohm with C17 1 uF to GND, and pulled low by the reset key S1. GPIO0 has R10 2.2 kohm to MCU_VDD. VDD_SDIO (pin 26) is decoupled by C44 1 uF; CAP1/CAP2 carry R29 20 kohm, C40 3.3 nF and C41 10 nF. GPIO37 (pin 6) is not connected. VDD_SDIO is 3.3 V from VDD3P3_RTC: R15 holds MTDI (GPIO12) low at reset, and the bench unit has no eFuse override (XPD_SDIO_FORCE not burned). The bench unit reads ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3 revision v3.1 (esptool, 2026-11-17).
The ESP32's main crystal. The schematic names the part only, not its frequency; 40 MHz was read from the chip by esptool on the bench unit (2026-11-17).

components.notes: Pin by pin from the core schematic: DCDC1 through L3 is MCU_VDD (test point TP2 'ESP_3V3'); LDO2 is PERI_VDD (TP3 'PERIPH_3V3'); LDO1 is RTC_VDD (TP5 'RTC_3V3'); IPSOUT/APS is IPS_BUS (TP4 'IPSOUT'), which also feeds VIN1-3 and LDOIN. GPIO0 (pin 19) drives BUS_PW_EN, the same net as N_VBUSEN (pin 6), which R5 10 kohm and C11 1 uF hold to GND. TS (pin 37) is tied to GND (no battery thermistor). N_OE (pin 4) is tied to GND. SYSEN (pin 29) is drawn on RTC_VDD. CHGLED (36), PWREN (27), GPIO3 (41), IRQ (48), N_RSTO (3) and the DCDC2 pins are not connected. BIAS has R4 200 kohm. The vendor table gives the charging current (0.219 A), the current after a full charge with the board off (0.055 A) and on (0.147 A).

The SY7088's inductor, between IPS_BUS and LX. The schematic gives its value only.
The AXP192's buck inductors: L3 on DCDC1 (MCU_VDD), L2 on DCDC3 (LCD backlight).

The built-in speaker on SPEAKER_PAD. Neither the schematic nor the vendor page gives its impedance or power.
Fed from the AXP192's LDO3 through R21 22 ohm, with D2 (1N4148) across it to GND as a flyback diode (VIB_MOTOR_PAD). The vendor warns that the motor interferes mechanically with Base series bases.

S1 is the reset key on the bottom edge.

connects_to.notes: Read from the core schematic the vendor links for v1.3, which is titled V1.0 and draws a CP2104-F03-GMR (U3) here: the UART nets, the 47 ohm series resistors and the auto-reset pair are taken from it, not from a CH9102F drawing.

pins.D+/D-: SYS_DP/SYS_DM, through R54/R55 47 ohm and the D8 ESD array to USB_DP/USB_DM

The Core2 v1.0 shipped with either a CP2104 or a CH9102, per the vendor's comparison table. The bench unit enumerates as USB 1a86:55d4 (WCH), product "USB Single Serial" (2026-11-17).
NPN pair driven by the bridge's DTR and RTS through R12/R13 10 kohm: Q1 pulls CHIP_PU (MCU_RST) low, Q2 pulls GPIO0 low through D1 (1N4148).
D1 sits in the auto-reset path to GPIO0; D2 is the vibration motor's flyback diode.

The far side is the stacked base; on this board the rear expansion board (BMI270 and microphone) sits on it.

notes: The board is two PCBs: the core (ESP32, AXP192, LCD, touch, RTC, speaker amplifier, microSD, USB) and a rear expansion board on the M5-Bus that carries the BMI270 and the PDM microphone. The vendor links one schematic per board; the core one is titled 'CORE2_V1.0_SCH' (printed 2020-07-07) and the expansion one 'core2_v1.3_SCH' (printed 2025-11-14). Where the v1.0 core drawing and the v1.3 specification table differ (the USB-UART bridge), both are recorded. Power nets: MCU_VDD (AXP192 DCDC1, 3.3 V by its test point label 'ESP_3V3' and the M5-Bus pin '3.3V'), PERI_VDD (LDO2), RTC_VDD (LDO1), IPS_BUS (IPSOUT), BUS_5V (the SY7088 boost, also the AXP192's VBUS), USB_5V (USB-C after FU1, the AXP192's ACIN), SYS_VBAT (battery). Test points TP1 to TP7: GND, ESP_3V3, PERIPH_3V3, IPSOUT, RTC_3V3 (twice, on RTC_VDD and PWR_KEY) and VB (SYS_VBAT). Certifications per the vendor: CE, MIC, FCC, RCM and IEC 62133.
